verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs show a pull-request review workflow: reviewing diffs, AI code review suggestions, and opening Jira tickets from the PR screen. That covers the 'propose changes via pull requests' half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents forking or cross-repository PRs from outside contributors. Missing for 10: documented repository forking, fork-to-upstream pull requests, outside/public contributor access, independent or hands-on corroboration of an open-source contribution workflow.
